item.text: The search pass recovered several previously missing primary locators: IAEA’s February 2023 GOV/2023/8 report, the November 2023 monitoring report GOV/2023/57, China’s trilateral Iran–Saudi statement, Treasury’s 19 September 2023 UAV-network designation, RSF’s 2023 index page, OHCHR’s 2023 case communication on Mohammadi/Sotoudeh, UN/OCHA’s Khoy response, and a contemporaneous Nowruz speech report. I’m now consolidating these into atomic, non-scoring ledger additions and explicitly downgrading claims that still only support institutional context.

Filesystem access remained read-only, so I could not persist `research-materials.md` or update `research-ledger-manifest.json`. I attempted the manifest patch; it was rejected by the sandbox. The following is the permissive handoff for parent persistence.

## 1B — Nuclear risk

Added or disposition-changed:

- `N013-IAEA-84pct-primary-Feb2023`: IAEA GOV/2023/8, paras. 34–36, records HEU particles up to 83.7% and Iran’s 20 February explanation of “unintended fluctuations.” This replaces the gateway-only portion of N001a. [IAEA GOV/2023/8](https://www.iaea.org/sites/default/files/documents/gov2023-8.pdf)
- `N014-IAEA-monitoring-gap-Nov2023`: IAEA GOV/2023/57, paras. 24–29, records removal of monitoring equipment, a 2-year-9-month gap in JCPOA verification, suspension of the Additional Protocol, and inspector withdrawals. [IAEA GOV/2023/57](https://www.iaea.org/sites/default/files/documents/gov2023-57.pdf)
- `N015-Iran-response-to-IAEA-Nov2023`: Iran’s Vienna mission claimed full compliance with safeguards and sufficient cooperation, providing direct contrary evidence. [Iranian mission explanatory note](https://www.iaea.org/sites/default/files/publications/documents/infcircs/2023/infcirc1159.pdf)

The end-2023 stockpile estimate and Khamenei-specific command ownership remain unresolved. No defensible new evidence was found for ally nuclear proliferation or expert-versus-loyalist advice. The chapter remains locator- and attribution-limited.

## 2B — International peace and security

Added:

- `I010-China-Iran-Saudi-trilateral-statement`: The 10 March 2023 joint statement records talks held 6–10 March, resumption of diplomatic relations, sovereignty, non-interference, and regional peace commitments. [China MFA statement](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/wjb/zzjg_663340/xybfs_663590/xwlb_663592/202303/t20230311_11039241.html)
- `I011-Iran-UAV-production-network-Sept2023`: Treasury’s 19 September designation identifies Iranian UAV-production entities and procurement of engines applicable to Shahed-series drones. This supports capability/procurement, not by itself a Khamenei order or proof of every transfer to Russia. [U.S. Treasury](https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy1745)
- `I012-Iran-drone-denial-Sept2023`: Iran’s foreign minister publicly denied the alleged scale of transfers, retained as contrary evidence. [Iran Primer chronology](https://iranprimer.usip.org/blog/2023/jan/17/timeline-us-sanctions-irans-drones-russia)

The Saudi détente now has a primary diplomatic locator and a genuine contrary/qualification record for drone attribution. Civilian-protection evidence, military-failure accountability, and a precise Khamenei command-chain record remain unavailable. Shortfall remains material.

## 3B — Domestic safety

Added:

- `D012-OHCHR-Mohammadi-Sotoudeh-2023`: UN Special Procedures communication records Mohammadi’s additional 2023 sentence, prison medical concerns, Sotoudeh’s arrest and alleged beating at Garavand’s funeral, and charges reported by Fars. [OHCHR communication](https://spcommreports.ohchr.org/TMResultsBase/DownLoadPublicCommunicationFile?gId=28612)
- `D013-OHCHR-protest-child-abuse-2023`: UN reporting corroborates child deaths, detention, and abuse allegations connected to the 2022–23 protest period. [UN Human Rights Council report](https://www.ohchr.org/sites/default/files/documents/hrbodies/hrcouncil/sessions-regular/session53/advance-versions/A-HRC-53-23-AdvanceUneditedVersion.pdf)
- `D014-HRW-dissent-crackdown-primary`: HRW’s 15 September 2023 report provides precise evidence for Nikbakht’s prosecution, university dismissals, student discipline, and the March amnesty statement. [Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/news/2023/09/15/iran-crackdown-dissent-ahead-protest-anniversary)

The new material strengthens independent corroboration and separates direct state actions from allegations. It still does not establish that Khamenei personally ordered the named abuses. The chapter has adequate event coverage but remains attribution-limited.

## 4B — Political freedom

Added:

- `P009-parliamentary-candidate-registration-Aug2023`: AP reports nearly 49,000 registrations for the March 2024 parliamentary election, with vetting scheduled to conclude in October; half of Guardian Council members are directly appointed by the Supreme Leader. This is a dated 2023 election-preparation event, not a 2023 election outcome. [Associated Press](https://apnews.com/article/1b23a5fe159f16a7277b2e851f134baf)
- `P010-RSF-2023-index-primary`: RSF’s 2023 table records Iran at rank 177/180 with score 24.81. [RSF 2023 ranking](https://rsf.org/es/clasificacion?year=2023)
- `P011-contrary-institutional-contestation`: AP records the unusually high registration volume and increased female registrations, a limited contrary indicator of participation within the restricted system. It does not negate Guardian Council control.

The chapter now has precise 2023 preparation evidence and a primary index locator. Direct evidence of Khamenei intervention in individual vetting, university dismissals, or press cases remains missing.

## 5B — Economic wellbeing

Added:

- `E008-Khamenei-Nowruz-1402-economic-program`: The 21 March 2023 Nowruz address named “inflation control and growth in production” as the year’s priorities and identified the economy and livelihoods as central concerns. [Tasnim report of the speech](https://www.tasnimnews.ir/en/news/2023/03/21/2870354/ayatollah-khamenei-names-new-iranian-year-inflation-control-growth-in-production)
- `E009-WorldBank-Iran-economic-monitor-2023`: The World Bank’s 2023 Iran Economic Monitor provides a contemporaneous economic-policy and welfare baseline, including moderate growth amid uncertainty, inflationary pressure, pension reform, and water-security challenges. [World Bank Iran Economic Monitor](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/iran/publication/iran-economic-monitor)
- `E010-WorldBank-2023-growth-contrary`: WDI records Iran’s 2023 GDP growth at approximately 5.0%, a contrary outcome to a wholly negative macroeconomic description. This is country-level outcome evidence, not personal attribution. [World Bank WDI](https://databank.worldbank.org/data/reports.aspx?country=IRN%2CARB&series=NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG&source=2)

Khamenei’s 2023 economic priority is now directly dated. Implementation, distribution, productivity, and policy-correction evidence remain thin; GDP growth must be retained as contrary outcome evidence rather than converted into a ruler judgment.

## 6B — Social wellbeing

Added:

- `S008-Khoy-earthquake-response-2023`: UN/OCHA records the 28 January 2023 Khoy earthquake and the humanitarian response through December 2023. [UN Iran/OCHA response report](https://iran.un.org/en/266264-iran-islamic-republic-khoy-earthquake-28-jan-2023-response-december-2023)
- `S009-UNHCR-Khoy-relief-delivery`: UNHCR records delivery of tents, tarpaulins, blankets, and other relief items, with government estimates of more than 35,000 people affected. [UNHCR Iran](https://www.unhcr.org/ir/news/unhcr-relief-items-arrive-irans-earthquake-affected-areas)
- `S010-OHCHR-prison-health-2023`: The OHCHR communication documents delayed or conditional medical access affecting detained human-rights defenders, including Mohammadi. [OHCHR communication](https://spcommreports.ohchr.org/TMResultsBase/DownLoadPublicCommunicationFile?gId=28612)

This supplies a concrete disaster-response record and a welfare-related contrary/positive response record. It does not establish Khamenei ownership of operational relief delivery. Health, education, water, sanitation, and durable reform remain substantially under-researched.

## 7B — Personal integrity

Added or corrected:

- `Y012-Treasury-Supreme-Leader-network-2020-persistent`: Treasury directly describes the Supreme Leader’s control of Bonyad Mostazafan and states that the network was used to enrich the Supreme Leader’s office and reward allies. This is a pre-period institutional fact that remained relevant in 2023, not a 2023 event. [U.S. Treasury, 18 November 2020](https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/sm1185)
- `Y013-Treasury-Mojtaba-role-2019-persistent`: Treasury states that Mojtaba Khamenei acted for or on behalf of Ali Khamenei and that Khamenei delegated part of his leadership responsibilities to him. This supports a documented relationship, but not a specific 2023 act, benefit, or knowledge concerning alleged misconduct. [U.S. Treasury, 4 November 2019](https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/sm824)
- `Y014-OHCHR-independent-investigation-constraint-2023`: The OHCHR communication records prosecutions and detention of defenders and lawyers, including Mohammadi and Sotoudeh. It supports an institutional-obstruction record; direct personal attribution to Ali Khamenei remains limited.

The Treasury material should replace unsupported “Mojtaba sanction proves Ali Khamenei integrity failure” language with a narrower disposition: documented Supreme Leader–office relationship, persistent patronage-network evidence, and unresolved personal attribution.

## 8B — Effectiveness and competence

Added:

- `X013-Nowruz-1402-explicit-program`: Khamenei’s dated 21 March 2023 program explicitly prioritized inflation control and production growth. [Tasnim report](https://www.tasnimnews.ir/en/news/2023/03/21/2870354/ayatollah-khamenei-names-new-iranian-year-inflation-control-growth-in-production)
- `X014-WorldBank-economic-outcomes-2023`: World Bank materials provide measurable contrary outcomes: approximately 5% GDP growth in WDI, while the Economic Monitor documents continuing inflation, uncertainty, pension reform needs, and water-security challenges. [WDI](https://databank.worldbank.org/data/reports.aspx?country=IRN%2CARB&series=NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG&source=2), [Iran Economic Monitor](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/iran/publication/iran-economic-monitor)
- `X015-Khoy-response-implementation`: UN/OCHA and UNHCR document a coordinated 2023 disaster response, providing a concrete implementation record and a counterweight to exclusively negative crisis-response evidence.
- `X016-election-mobilization-2023`: AP’s nearly 49,000 parliamentary registrations provide a dated personnel/electoral mobilization fact, though the subsequent vetting system constrained participation.

The chapter now has one dated program statement, measurable positive and negative outcome records, and a concrete crisis-response implementation record. Direct evidence linking Khamenei personally to personnel selection quality, cross-government coordination, or specific 2023 policy corrections remains insufficient.

- Replace or supplement I003a with Treasury’s 19 September 2023 UAV designation.
- Retain I004 as `context` plus `locator_missing`; no exact Khamenei primary statement was recovered.
- Retain N001b as `locator_missing`; the exact end-2023 IAEA stockpile table was not recovered.
- Retain X005/E006 pension-budget claims as `context` and `locator_missing`.
- Reclassify country-level GDP, RSF, World Bank, SIPRI, CPI, and welfare indicators as context/outcome evidence, not personal ruler conduct.
- Do not create duplicate chapter-specific IDs for cross-reused evidence.
